title: Susan Gough by Kirkpatrick's side at George Mason event

tellings.quote: I met Kirk Patrick in person and I was there at that incident and she was attached at his hip would not leave.

plain: A witness named Merrick told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he met Sean Kirkpatrick, then head of the Pentagon's UFO office, in person at an event at George Mason University in Virginia in November 2023. He says Susan Gough, a Pentagon spokesperson, was attached at Kirkpatrick's hip and would not leave his side. Merrick tells it as a sign that the official was being closely managed.
